instruction: Give me a random funny quote from my SimpleNote note about it. Just the quote, nothing else.
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the model only contains lookup actions plus supervisor.complete_task. The note id is discovered via simple_note.search_notes (static fact note-matches links the query to the note), and the quote is read from simple_note.show_note content (static fact quote-in-note). The quote object is the answer parameter of supervisor-complete-task; its precondition is the goal condition (found-quote ?qt), so it is necessarily the last action. The supervisor person object is included by convention but unused in predicates.
